correctness.rationale: Reconstructed independent first-arrival competition on the acyclic decorated path. The one-sided failure F_l obeys F_l(t)=1-α∫_0^t exp[-(α+β)s]F_(l-1)(s)ds and F_0=1, so with x=g(1-e^(-(α+β)t)) gives F_l=Σ_{j=0}^l(-x)^j/j!. Integrating βe^-βt F_(i-1)F_(L-i) and beta factorial identity a B(j+k+1,a)=(j+k)!/∏_{h=1}^{j+k}(a+h) proves the exact finite sum. Alternating-series remainder on 0≤gu≤1 bounds each branch by (gu)^ell+1/(ell+1)!, giving the printed two-side factorial bound; dominated convergence yields the bulk confluent hypergeometric integral. Coupling/exponential representation in ratio b=β/α gives strict increase, limit e^-2 as b↓0, strong-b 1-1/b+O(b^-2), and t=u/β limit e^-2(1-e^-u), distinct from exactly β=0. Independently exact CTMC first-success recursion reproduced 84 cases (L<=6, three rate pairs, every site). Local infinite-volume influence paths are factorially suppressed on bounded-degree graph. No infinite claim inferred from the finite tests.
